findings.title: The individual record remains the object received
findings.claim: The passive delivery keeps each person's own record at the center of the condition, even as the scene begins with a summons of groups.

epistemic.reason: The accepted analysis-to-QAC links and local passive/object morphology directly support the personal record relation.

findings.title: The record is written and assembled
findings.claim: The repeated kitab carries a personal deed-record as a written object, while its joining pressure lets the account be heard as assembled material.
findings.mechanism: The book is received and then read, activating the written-text facets; its repetition across the two clauses and contact with the reading verb activate the bounded joined-account analogy.
findings.reader_payoff: The record becomes a text that can be held, read, and understood as an account with joined contents.
findings.containment: The personal record remains the local referent. The joined-account relation is an interpretive image, not a claim about literal book construction or a binding decree; 17:13-14 are excluded.

epistemic.reason: The written-object reading is direct; the joined-account facet is qualified by the local repetition and reading contact.
